title: KeySetSerialized (canonical)
description: Wire format v1 for @eturino/key-set, canonical profile: exactly what serialized() emits, and nothing else. The sibling key-set.schema.json describes what parseKeySet() accepts, which is deliberately wider. Use this one to validate a hand-edited file that embeds a key set, so a tolerated-but-never-emitted form is an error at edit time rather than a value that does not mean what it looks like. Same wire format, same v1, same $defs names as the permissive profile: switching costs one $id. Three element profiles are addressable as $defs: #/$defs/keySet (any Key), #/$defs/keyLabelSet (IKeyLabel only) and #/$defs/stringKeySet (string only). Pin a git tag instead of `master` for an immutable URL. Two things this file cannot express: elements are sorted on emit, and IKeyLabel elements are deduplicated by `key`, so two entries with the same key and different labels are not emitted either (uniqueItems does not catch that pair).

keySetType.title: KeySetTypes
keySetType.description: Discriminator. ALL is the whole universe, NONE the empty set, SOME an explicit set, ALL_EXCEPT_SOME the complement of an explicit set.

keyLabel.title: IKeyLabel
keyLabel.description: A key paired with a human-readable label. Additional properties stay permitted even here: the library stores the element object it is handed and emits it unchanged, so `{ key, label, anything }` is genuinely part of the emit.

keySetAll.title: KeySetAllSerialized
keySetAll.description: serialized() emits `{ type: "ALL" }`. An empty `elements` array parses, but is not emitted, so it is refused here.

keySetNone.title: KeySetNoneSerialized
keySetNone.description: serialized() emits `{ type: "NONE" }`. An empty `elements` array parses, but is not emitted, so it is refused here.

keyLabelSet.title: KeyLabelSetSerialized
keyLabelSet.description: Same shape as keySet, restricted to IKeyLabel elements.

stringKeySet.title: StringKeySetSerialized
stringKeySet.description: Same shape as keySet, restricted to string elements: no numbers, no IKeyLabel. For a file format whose keys are string ids. Narrowing further (a pattern, an enum) is an allOf away, see the README.

composedKeySet.title: ComposedKeySetSerialized
composedKeySet.description: A ComposedKeySet serializes as the plain array of its members. An empty array is not produced: the library normalises an empty list to a single ALL.
